ID: RM-DOC-0502
Title: Brenmark car plants feel the rail outage
Source: Runewire
Published: 2025-04-03
Type: news_report
Event: EVT-D
Country: Brenmark
Sector: automotive
Tier: 2

About 50 percent of Brenmark's automotive parts imports travel on the Ironway Rail Link, according to rail operator data.

Skarline Motors said deliveries to Brenmark would be delayed.
